question.problem:
Let $R=[1,4]\times [2,4]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)=x+2y-3.$
Further, let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}=\{1,2,3,4\},\,{P}_{2}=\{2,3,4\},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the upper Riemann sum $U(f,P).$
question.worked_solution:
First, let's draw the region $R$ and the partition $P.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/89c82b8d1f3eaf79c7df0a67f377a240a949dda328cd2f448370077d2871c244.png)

The upper sum $U(f,P)$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & ={M}_{11}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{11})+{M}_{21}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{21})+{M}_{31}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{31}) \\  & \,+{M}_{12}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{12})+{M}_{22}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{22})+{M}_{32}\cdot \text{Area}({R}_{32}),\end{aligned}
$$

where ${M}_{ij}$ is the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ We pick the *maximum* value of $f$ because we're finding the *upper* sum.

Taking into account the fact that $\text{Area}({R}_{ij})=1$ for all $6$ subregions, the formula for $U(f,P)$ reduces to

$$
U(f,P)={M}_{11}+{M}_{21}+{M}_{31}+{M}_{12}+{M}_{22}+{M}_{32}.
$$

Now, notice that

- $f(x,y)=x+2y-3$ increases as $x$ increases, and

- $f(x,y)=x+2y-3$ increases as $y$ increases.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/7888eaa17b26267cc8bed166500ba504fe5a893b30eb90876f2074520e28e8ba.png)

As a result, the *maximum* value of $f$ in each subregion is attained when we have the *largest* possible $x$ and the *largest* possible $y.$ This is the value at the *top right corner* of each subregion.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14225859/assets/eadef808ebc8ff5503de8cefbbbf3a1d64bf3149f0c0c80166c891550ddee91d.png)

Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{11} & =f(2,3)=5 \\ {M}_{21} & =f(3,3)=6 \\ {M}_{31} & =f(4,3)=7 \\ {M}_{12} & =f(2,4)=7 \\ {M}_{22} & =f(3,4)=8 \\ {M}_{32} & =f(4,4)=9\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}U(f,P) & =5+6+7+7+8+9 \\  & =42.\end{aligned}
$$
